verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's only recurring job is a built-in automatic daily local backup that the user can switch on. It is not a general scheduler: it runs once per day only when the app is opened, and the user cannot define custom jobs, workflows or frequencies. The CLI and the 'script a workflow' note are building blocks that would need an external scheduler, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules, configurable frequency or timing, scheduling of arbitrary workflows, execution that does not depend on opening the app, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automatic daily backups: When enabled, Ente Auth creates one local backup per day when you open the app.
Open `Settings > Data > Local backup` to enable automatic local backups
